reviews.text: I cannot recommend Monster Minders enough! From the awesome admin team that makes things run smoothly to Tyler our awesome minder, I have been blown away. I would recommend Monster Minders to anyone looking for a dog walking service in Philly!

We love Monster Minders!  Can't recommend highly enough. Emily is so thoughtful and conscientious. And our pup LOVES her. We also really appreciate that there are back-up walkers available on days when Emily needs to be out.

The team at Monster Minders (Chris, Lindsey, Carrie) are a stellar group of folks who became an integral part of our daily lives. We have pups with a LOT of energy, who at times have complicated relationships with squirrels/skateboards/etc. but they were always so taken care of on their walks with the team. There isn’t a more capable, thoughtful, and reliable group of people to take care of your dogs!

Everyone at the Monster Minders has been an absolute lifesaver! I recently adopted a rescue dog named Fable who ended up being much higher energy and less leash/potty trained than originally thought, which I had been trying to avoid because I work in-office full-time. With her excited dog reactivity, I knew doggy daycare wouldn't be a feasible option. Knowing that she's in great hands for her daytime walks is a huge relief, and the updates that I get always make my day.

Fable loved Everest right away, and he's been amazing with her. He and the everyone on the Monster Minders team do a great job taking all the changes to Fable's routine in stride--and there have been a lot as we do a lot of trial and error to see what helps Fable with her separation anxiety. I can tell that going on walks with Everest brings her a lot of joy during the day!

We have had such a wonderful experience with dog walking services from Monster Minders! From the very start, Carrie and the whole team were very communicative, and we knew our dog was in great hands. Rowan was our walker, and he provided such lovely reports including details like the walk route, our dog's behavior, and several adorable photos. When Rowan had an injury preventing him from walking, the Monster Minders team provided updates and coordinated with other walkers to make it an entirely stress-free experience on our end. We are grateful to Alex and Terra for their help and were excited to have Rowan back a few weeks later. Everyone's walk reports really show how much this team loves and cares for animals!

Aside from the wonderful people at Monster Minders, scheduling services through the portal is super easy. We always receive timely responses to our requests to reschedule walks. We highly recommend Monster Minders!!
Been using for a few weeks now and extremely happy!! The updates after each walk are great! The walker seems to deal with our high energy dog very well!!

Could not be happier with the service my puppy gets! Everyday I receive an update with pictures of my pup and update on bathroom, water changes and treats! I even got the opportunity to see my pup interact with Patricia when I was working from home one day. We saw Patricia on a walk and Petunia was so excited and happy to see her. It made me so happy knowing Petunia is happy with her walkies and loves Patricia! The app is user friendly and very easy to cancel/reschedule. Highly recommend and will be able to put your mind at ease while you’re at work/out and receive an update on your dog!!

I found MM through Yelp and have been so pleased with them! Garvin is prompt, attentive, and always provides thorough / timely updates. “Onboarding” was quick and easy with the ability to schedule through the app as soon as the day after the meet up. If you’re in need of a dog walker in Philly, I highly recommend MM.

We've had a wonderful experience with Monster Minders over the past four years and couldn't recommend them more highly. The team has always been reliable, communicative, and genuinely caring, giving us complete peace of mind knowing our dog, Winnie, was in great hands.

A special thank you to Isabel and Jakub. Isabel was incredibly patient and kind with Winnie, who can be slow to warm up to new people. She built such a wonderful bond with her, and it was obvious how much she truly cared. We're so grateful for everything she did and will miss her very much.

Jakub has been equally amazing—dependable, thoughtful, and fantastic with Winnie. It's been so reassuring knowing she's continued to receive the same exceptional attention, and she's always happy to see him.

We're incredibly grateful to the entire Monster Minders team, especially Isabel and Jakub, for everything they've done for Winnie over the years.

Britt is an exceptional dog walker! She gives our pup Oreo a lot of love and attention. I really like her reports. Britt is a thoughtful person and the whole family loves her. Oreo is always a happy guy after his time with Britt.

Monster Minders overall is a great business. We have been with them for nearly two years and I appreciate how reliable they are. I know if for some reason Britt is sick or the weather is bad that Oreo will be taken care of. Also, Carrie always answers our questions and checks in regularly. The app they use is easy to update and simple for rescheduling. Highly recommend their services.

Carrie and Lindsay- I can't thank you both enough for taking care of my Sadie throughout the years. I knew that she was always in good hands with you and the minders. And, I always knew I would come back for your services. You are always there and we can depend on you and trust you in our homes. It is a big relief to have you by my side throughout the years. Now, with my Bandit, we have Chris, as our minder. He is the best minder and he clicked with Bandit right away. His personal notes and pictures put a smile on face every day. I look forward to it.  I would recommended any one looking for someone to take care of their pet to Monster Minders. You guys are amazing!

The Monster Minders are a great dog walking service. My dog gets walked every week day by Everest, and she is happier for it! The daily updates make my day, and I can see the joy in my dog's face in every picture.

I am so happy to have found Monster Minders. It is a relief to know that my pup is well taken care of while I’m at work. Walks are easy to schedule, and our minder Rowan sends me the cutest pictures from their walk. It’s the highlight of my work day! My dog has separation anxiety and is nervous with strangers, but the Monster Minder team worked so well with him in the beginning that I can tell my dog sees Rowan as a best friend now. I would 100% recommend them if you have a dog in the city.

We have been using The Monster Minders for a weekly midday walk for a while and have nothing but great things to say. The communication is great from first contact through regular updates. We get personal updates and pictures after each walk so we know our dog has been well cared for and she clearly gets excited when Summer comes to get her. The scheduling is also simple and easy to modify or add services as needed.

We have been using Monster Minders for well over a decade. We have always found them to be professional, reliable, friendly, and thoughtful.  The online booking system is so easy, and communications are always timely and clear. Our dog Chase absolutely loves his time with his minder, Kerry, and it's clear from her interactions with him and us that the feeling is mutual. We always feel confident when our pets are in the Monster Minders' care, and are grateful for all the support Carrie, Lindsay, Kerry and the entire team gives to us. 10/10 Highly Recommend

The entire team at Monster Minders is so wonderful - they do a great job of balancing the wellness of both the Minders and the pups, and they have always been incredibly communicative and transparent. This combination fostered confidence and trust that I valued not just 4.5 years ago when I first brought home a foster puppy but also during the many stages after that.

We love the monster minders!! Emily is our dog walker for our golden retriever, Jett and she is the best! She is extremely reliable & we know she will always take great care of our pup while we are at work. She sends the best updates mid-day with some very silly photos of our dog, which always give us a good laugh. Monster minders in general is also extremely quick to respond with any schedule changes or questions I have - which we really appreciate. Highly recommend!

We're so happy to have Monster Minders minding our monster! They take such care with him — he's 15 and has difficult walking. They go at his pace and make sure to give him extra attention during their visits. Our neighbors even comment to us regularly how kind our walkers (Nikki and Alex) are and they can see how much they love our dog. They're wildly communicative in the best way, reliable and respectful. We couldn't be happier.
The monster minders have been such a great help! Scout and Tyler are always so sweet with my dog and send amazing updates on him for every walk!

We’ve had an amazing experience working with Monster Minders! Their app is incredibly user-friendly and accessible, making it easy to schedule walks, communicate with them, and receive daily reports about our little guy after every walk. The payment process is also seamless, convenient and stress-free.

We greatly appreciate the level of care and attention Jasper, our dog walker, gives our little guy. They’ve taken the time to understand his personality, routines, and quirks. We always receive thoughtful updates and photos after walks! Their professionalism, care, and attention to detail has made a huge difference for us. We cannot recommend working with Monster Minders enough!

Monster Minders has cared for our family’s 17-year-old dog for nearly a decade, providing consistent and dependable service. Our walker Kerry is exceptional, her genuine care and attention make all the difference. We feel completely at ease knowing our dog is in such good hands when we are not home.

We have trusted monster minders with our dog for ten years plus. Our dog is a tough girl since she doesn't like anyone who isn't in her inner circle. We joke that she loves three people in the world myself, my husband, and Shannon our monster minder. We truly couldn't be happier with monster minders and particularly Shannon. Thanks for taking such good care of our special girl!

Monster Minders is fantastic! They are incredibly kind and understanding when my schedule changes and have worked with me to ensure Ernie gets an additional walk on unexpectedly busy days. After a week of vacation, Ernie literally ran to the door to see Chris when they were reunited. The daily updates are the best part of my day. So grateful to know Ernie is so well loved and cared for.

I’ve been using Monster Minders for over 3 years now. Being a family-owned business, Carrie & Lindsey truly care about your dog and treat them like their own - hiring incredible minders (walkers) for their business. Everyone is so reliable, kind, and professional, and it gives me so much peace of mind knowing my boy is in such good hands. Kerry especially is incredible — caring, trustworthy, and my dog genuinely looks forward to his walks with her like no other. From one dog mom to another, I can’t recommend Monster Minders enough if you want peace of mind knowing your dog will be cared and loved for whenever they are with their Minders!

Wow, we cannot say enough good things about Monster Minders. We have been loyal customers for over 15 years. We started with them immediately after getting our pug puppy. Not only did the initial minders help walk her and feed her when we were at work, they also helped train her to walk better with a leash and in the city.

All the minders we have had over the years have been incredibly sweet, kind, and patient with our little bossy dog. Our pug is incredibly stubborn and at (now 15 years old) VERY set in her ways. She gets what she wants and is quite vocal if those wants are not met. But the minute her minder Alex walks in, our pug changes into a sweet, innocent girl. While we are lucky to get kisses, our dog showers Alex with them. I understand! Alex is very good at adapting to her senior needs. Alex carries our dog up and down stairs, curbs, over snow banks and salted winter sidewalks (which can hurt paws). We love that Alex can get her to walk longer on beautiful days, Alex takes a few photos and posts them to the Monster Minders' App. We have instant notifications on how our dog's walk went.

Normally, I have summers to work from home and we stop Monster Minders, but our dog loves Alex so much, that we decided to keep her for the summer.

I recommend Monster Minders to anyone that asks about dog walking services. Carrie (the owner) is quick to respond to any messages you leave her, she is also good to let customers know about weather challenges on the way (or on going). The website/profie/app makes managing walks, scheduling, and communication easy.

Thank you Monster Minders, we love you!

My experience with Monster Minders, and in particular Nicolette, has been nothing short of exceptional. From day one, it was clear they genuinely care about the dogs they work with. They’re reliable, communicative, and go above and beyond to make sure my dog is not only walked, but happy and well cared for.

I always get detailed updates after each walk, often with photos, which gives real peace of mind during the day. They’re attentive to my dog’s needs, mindful of routines, and quick to notice anything out of the ordinary.

The level of professionalism and kindness they bring is hard to find. It’s such a relief knowing my dog is in such capable hands. I wouldn’t hesitate to recommend them to anyone looking for a trustworthy, dedicated, and truly outstanding dog walker.

I am so grateful for Monster Minders and specifically Shannon. Our pup has some anxiety issues and Shannon has been so patient and helpful w offering suggestions and listening to what our pup needs each visit. She truly cares and we feel like she’s part of our family. Love all the photos and updates. So happy to have Monster Minders in our lives.

Everyone at Monster Minders has been amazing. Britt is my dog Casey’s current walker and she is truly a delight. Britt and Casey have a special bond. It warms my heart to see Casey’s tail wag when she sees Britt arrive. I love reading Britt’s updates after their walks. It’s clear that for Britt this is more than a job, and I am so grateful for her warmth and dedication.

I’ve had such great experiences with MM for well over 10 years now, and can’t say enough good things about them. Communication is great, the care is exceptional, and it’s obvious that Carrie and Lindsay (the owners) care deeply about taking good care of their employees as well as the fur fam they’re looking after. Shannon, my Minder, has done such awesome work over the past several years with my sweet but reactive pittie, and is so attentive and intuitive she alerted me midday to a change in my dog’s behavior which led to identifying a health issue that I was able to nip in the.bud before it escalated. It’s so deeply reassuring to know my girls are in such caring and capable hands.

When we first moved to Philly we shopped around for a dog walker for our pup, Nellie, and were very happy to land on Monster Minders. The reviews were not exaggerating! Our minder, Thom, treats Nellie like she were his own pup. We love his daily stories about their neighborhood adventures and regularly share his comments with our friends and family. His patience and dedication to winning over a pup who is iffy with men has not gone unnoticed, and Nellie now absolutely loves him. Would highly recommend Monster Minders to friends and family!

We have had a wonderful experience with Monster Minders with our 1 year old bullmastiff! We were able to get started with them so quickly after a great introductory meeting and since then it has been such a great experience. We love the pictures after each walk and how easy it is to schedule and change walks. Our dog loves his walker too, and I am happy knowing he is in such great hands!
Julie has taken wonderful care of our dog for years, can't recommend them enough!

Have used Monster Minders for a few years now.  They are excellent and the staff and team are very organized.  Kerry and Olivia have been walking my dog and they are so caring and good to him.   Lindsey and Carrie also are excellent owners and always communicate what is happening during weather events, etc.   Thank you Monster Minders team!!!

We love Monster Minders and Kerry! We have been loyal clients for 4.5 years and we wouldn’t want to change a thing. Kerry is punctual,  communicative, and understands our dog’s quirks very well. We get wonderful reports after each walk, so we know her daily activities. In our time with MM they’ve never missed a walk or flaked. I know my dog is well taken care of each time Kerry comes to visit; thanks MM!

We highly recommend Monster Minders. To start, we had a quick and comprehensive onboarding process, including use of a robust app, clarity regarding scheduling (including changes that may arise) and billing. The assignment of a dedicated walker and doing only single dog walking provides great continuity and attentive service. Our Minder, Steven, is fantastic...from timely arrival, including greeting our puppy with enthusiasm, through the walk and safe return home. He shares one or more photos and a brief description of each walk which is varied and engaging for our puppy. Finally, customer service is excellent. This includes prompt responses with a friendly and "can-do" attitude, whether for service changes, as needed, and addressing other questions. makes the customer. We heartily recommend Monster Minders for dog walking services!

We have been using Monster minders for over 3 years now and they never ever  let us down even when the rest of the world does! Our dog is in the best  possible hands with Terra whoo is both reliable,tender hearted AND funny!  She regales us with funny things Toby does and photos to support! Our dog is the child we never had and Terra treats him like we do.  Trusting anyone with keys to your house AND keys to your heart can be hard but Monster Minders gives us peace of mind on all fronts.  Their scheduling and communication os at a level I don't see anywhere else.  They are responsive and join in your joy and your sadness when the loss of a pet occurs.  We are grateful beyond measure for them as well as how they treat their employees.  That is very important to us as well.

I have used Monster Minders for over 2 years now and they have been consistently exceptional! My Belle can be leash reactive and the minders have always taken the time to understand her quirks and make sure she is good to go. Everest has been her walker for a while now and even though she can be fearful of men he took the time to just sit with her and let her adjust for a full week before taking her out on walks. I would recommend Monster Minders to anyone!

We have been using MM for last seven years. Truly the most reliable, communicative and loving dog walking service in Philadelphia . They take such good care of their clients and  staff— a true rarity in the care giving industry.

Monster Minders is the best. They take care to get to know your dog at the start and then are super responsive to changes/questions. Our dog looks forward to his walks every day and Julie’s pictures of the excursions are always a bright spot while I’m in the office.

Over the moon with happiness how Nikki cares for Frankie! Frankie is a very fearful pup of the city noises and Nikki really shows her so much love and patience.  I am so grateful Franks has these guys in her life <3

Monster Minders has been a life saver since bringing our new rescue pup Rupert into our lives! He looks forward to his weekly walks with Summer and he always seems so happy when I get home to get some time out of the house while we are at work!

Julie is THE BEST! Seriously. She is wonderful with our dog Kingsley (they are besties), always says hi to our cat Ashland, and is also just a really nice and friendly person. When I am working from home it is always a pleasure to chat with her :)

We are so thrilled with Monster Minders!  The team is incredibly responsive and flexible and very easy to work with.  Our minder really bonded with our pup and we feel like he is in very good hands.  I look forward to my daily reports which are always funny and informative and make me think that my pup is having a great adventure.  I was sad to leave my pup in the morning but I felt a little comforted knowing he was going to see his friend during the day.  I highly recommend this service, you won't be disappointed.

We have loved working with Monster Minders over the past two years and have come to depend on them for weekday afternoon walks. Knowing that our dogs are taken care of while we’re at work gives us invaluable peace of mind. In addition to their reliability, we especially appreciate how proactive and communicative the company is.  Goose and Roo are always excited for walks with their minder Tyler, and we look forward to the thoughtful updates and pictures that Tyler provides after every walk.

I have been a client of Monster Minders for countless years. My dog household has changed over time, as have the minders (due to moves on my part), but what hasn't changed is the care given to my dogs as they move(d) through the phases of their lives. Did they need to slow down as the years passed for this dog? Does this dog need more time to become trusting? Whatever the need, they responded with kindness and communication. I'm immensely grateful for their services and care.

The Monster Minders are absolutely fantastic and we're so grateful for them (and especially Everest!). They are extremely professional and care a lot about our dog, and are always on time and extremely consistent. Our dog loves her walker and we love the Monster Minders too!

Amazing team at Monster Minders!  Reliable and friendly - my little guy has some codependence but Scout had him looking forward to their visits immediately!  Provides huge piece of mind when I can't be there!

We have had such a wonderful experience with Monster Minders, and especially with Emily P. From day one, the company has been incredibly reliable, professional, and easy to work with. It gives us so much peace of mind knowing our dog is in such good hands.

Emily is truly amazing. She is kind, attentive, and clearly loves what she does. Our dog absolutely adores her and genuinely looks forward to his walks every single day. The excitement when Emily arrives says it all! She takes the time to make each walk special, and we can tell how much she cares.

If you’re looking for a trustworthy, dependable dog walking company, I couldn’t recommend Monster Minders enough — and if you’re lucky enough to work with Emily P., you and your pup will be so happy you did!

Monster minders has been a part of my pups life since day one (we literally met Lindsey the day after I brought him home) and they are truly the best!  Carrie and team are always quick to respond and flexible to schedule last minute walk requests.

I love my daily notes from my minder and think their app is an excellent form of communication.

I couldn’t recommend them enough!
Monster Minders is the ABSOLUTE BEST! They are incredibly reliable and communicative. Carrie, the owner, is incredibly responsive and it's been a real game-changer for us. So glad we found them.

Highly recommend Monster Minders to folks looking for a dog walker. The walkers are incredibly thoughtful and take the time to get to know your pup and learn their quirks. The admin team is top-notch, very responsive, and super helpful. So glad we found Monster Minders!

Monster Minders has been a tremendous addition to our dog's weekly routine.  The team is communicative, responsive, thorough and trustworthy.  Our dog walker, Summer, is fantastic and we are glad we signed up.

We have had the best experience with The Monster Minders!! From our first meeting with Lindsay and having Emily as our walker we know Poppy is in great hands! Carrie is also extremely responsive and helpful. Emily sends us the sweetest summaries of her walks and takes the cutest photos. THE BEST!!

I’ve been using Monster Minders for over ten years, and I can honestly say they are the best pet-care team you’ll find in Philadelphia. Not only did they walk my dogs for more than a decade, but they were also a trusted resource whenever I needed advice—whether it was about trainers, medical care, or any other dog-related concern.
Garvin was our primary walker, and he was truly exceptional. Over the years, he became part of our family (or really, part of our pack!). I’ve had dogs with challenging personalities and, later in life, age-related issues like blindness. Through every phase, I never once worried when they were in Garvin’s care. His kindness, patience, and intuitive understanding of my dogs made all the difference. Honestly, I think my dogs believed he was their dad!
We’ve had substitute walkers over the years as well, and every single one of them has been professional, reliable, and caring. The entire Monster Minders team sets the standard for what great pet care should look like.
I cannot recommend this company—or any of their walkers—highly enough. If you’re looking for people who will love and care for your pets as if they were their own, Monster Minders is it.
A wonderful organization to work with! Their service is reliable and personal to your pets needs.

The Monster Minders are absolutely the BEST dog walking service in the city. They are incredibly reliable, communicative, and trustworthy with my fur baby. They truly try their best to maintain the same walker for your pet in order to foster a consistent relationship for the walker AND your pet. The scheduling app allows for flexibility as well, but still values consistency over everything. Their employees (I've had 2 walkers and also Lindsay and Carrie) are clearly valued at their job, and it's clear that the employees take pride in their work and are well taken care of. I believe that massively reflects in their work. The walk updates are always so enthusiastic and put a smile on my face just when I'm missing my pup the most! I cannot recommend them enough.
Monster Minders is an awesome service. The  team has figured this business out and they are extraordinarily caring, thoughtful and trustworthy. 100% peace of mind, especially with our Minder Britt!

Amazing company- my dog absolutely loves Lindsay (and anyone who fills in). They provide daily updates including pictures which truly make my day! The owners are so kind and attentive- highly highly recommend the Monster Minders!
I could not be more happy with our experience at Monster Minders.  They are reliable, professional and care for my pets like they are their own.  They are the best!

I've used the monster minders on a weekly basis for more than three years for our border collie mix. Great communication, excellent staff and caring and knowledgeable dog walkers (shout out to Britt!). I highly recommend!

We just left Monster Minders after about 3 years.  We loved our minder, and the company gave reliable service, including replacement minders when ours was out.  We are leaving because their billing practices are..erratic.  Over the years we've identified bills for walks that didn't happen, and overbilling (adding services). They have always corrected them when we brought  issues to  attention, but never once did they bring them to OUR attention.  We were overbilled over $100 just last month.  Its too much work to stay on top of it, and they are pretty cavalier with their "oopsie" responses.  Thats the end of a long relationship for us.

10 out of 5 if you ask me! This is the best dog walking business i have ever worked with - they were so responsive and acommodating. Tyler was absolutely amazing with out dog Charlie and we felt so comfortable b/c we knew he was taking good care of our pup!
Thanks for trusting us for the last two years!

Monster Minders is amazing! I've used them for 4+ years for regular weekday walks. The app is super easy to use and communication is always clear and quick with pictures and updates from every visit. Every walker (and owner) I’ve met has been so friendly and reliable and my dog is always excited to see them. I love knowing my dog is in good hands. They’re great about making sure a walk always happens, even if someone has to call out—there’s always coverage. Really dependable and caring service, highly recommend!

Monster Minders (and our wonderful walker, Julie) i've been such a great addition to our lives. They are timely, consistent, reliable, and most of all life our fur baby as much as we do. Julie is a professional dog photographer- and our lazy little man is always beyond happy to see her! Cannot say enough positive things and so grateful for the help they have provided our family.

The very best there is! The fantastic team at the Monster Minders cared for my elderly dog, Max for several years after we moved from NYC to Philly. I cannot say enough positives about them — they are communicative, contentious, responsible and trustworthy. As a true “helicopter” dog mom of a then medically challenging elderly dog, I was very scared of having to transition to a new walker following our move from NYC but from day one my experience with the whole Monster Minders team (shout out to Carrie and Patricia!) made me feel comfortable and like my boy was getting the very best care. If you have a dog in Philly in need of walks/care, look no further! You will not find anyone better. I miss this team terribly now that we live in the ‘burbs!

Have been using Monster Minders, specially Shannon for 3 years now and could not be happier! We love knowing that our pup gets some love and attention while we are at work all day. The updates we get via the app give us a little burst of happiness during the work day. Shannon takes amazing care of our dog. Not once in the 3 years have we ever been canceled on or had to arrange other care for our pup. Could not reccomend Monster Minders enough.
Monsters minders is the absolute best. We have been using them since 2018 and wouldn’t trust our anxious pup with anyone else!

I have been using Monster Minders for several years now and the whole team does an outstanding job! They are attentive, caring and thoughtful- I highly recommend them if you are looking for reliable dog walkers!

I have used monster minders for my bernedoodle for the last two years and they have been nothing short of exceptional!
Patricia, Emily, and Everest all took incredible care of my puppy. I had the same two or three dog walkers every day, so my dog got to know them really well. They were incredibly flexible in adding/canceling my walks when my (very variable) schedule changed, even at the last minute. It gave me peace of mind knowing that even if one of our walkers was sick or the weather was too hot/snowy, someone would still be at my door to walk my dog. I would recommend them 100x over!
The Monster Minders do a great job! We have been using Garvin for months now and our dog loves him. Their app is easy to use for scheduling walks and they do a great job of communicating issues.

Monster Minders walker Chris is fantastic—always reliable and clearly enjoys spending time with my dog — which means a lot to us since Moishe can be challenging to warm up
to. Chris leaves thoughtful notes after each walk. It gives me such peace of mind knowing Moishe is in such good hands.

The world's best dog walkers. We originally hired them because I broke my leg and couldn't give my border collie the walks she needed but kept using them long after my leg healed because they are just so great with our pooches! Can't recommend Monster Minders (and Nikki) enough.

We used Monster Minders for two years for our dog Pippin, and we can’t recommend them enough! Our two minders were Emilie and Emily - both were excellent, and Pippin loved them so much. It’s a huge relief to know that even if your normal minder is sick, Monster Minders will make sure that your pup gets their walk and some attention in. The descriptions and photos Emily sent were always so fun to receive. Would absolutely recommend this service!

Monster Minders is incredible! They are expert communicators, reliable, and trustworthy. And Nicolette is the absolute best! My dog loves her, and I know she looks after my pup with the utmost care and attention. There's no one better!

Monster Minders has been exceeding our expectations since day one. On days that our minder, Jasper, walks our pup, he is so much happier and content. I really appreciate the notes and cute photos of my dog after each walk that Jasper takes the time to write up. Monster Minders is also super easy to schedule with, and I have had no issues communicating any changes or heads up with them. We feel so lucky to have found Monster Midners!

I have had the Monster Minders help me with midday walks for my dog Luna since she was about 8 months old and she is turning 13 later this year. I have found them to be absolutely wonderful for over a decade. Our current Minder is Emily, and she is so good with Luna. I trust her to care for my dog the way I do, and Luna loves her and her daily walk time. I also get a daily note with a photo about Luna's walk and it is the absolute highlight of my day - Emily is a photo genius. I cannot recommend the Monster Minders enough. I truly have peace of mind and complete trust in their care.

I love this company!! I am at ease knowing that my dog is taken care of by his excellent walker Britt and that owners Carrie and Lindsay are at the helm making sure everything runs smoothly. I never stress. Fair prices, friendly people, and A+ communication. We love Monster Minders.

Our two dogs - Kygo and Kasbo - were so happy to get walks from our walker Tyler! The company was great with communication, and the app works with no problems. I was happy that if I was busy with work I wouldn't have to wait until the end of the day to take the dogs out. I liked how it was always the same walker, and we liked our walker too! Tyler took great pictures of our dogs each day, some of which we considered framing, and I think one of those pictures is on my wife's phone background. We had a great experience and would recommend it to anyone. 5 stars.

Stuart Austin
&
Rhiannon Ross

It's hard to express how much we love the Monster Minders and I'd give 10 stars if I could. We've worked with them for nearly 9 years, the bulk of which was working with Minder Julie, who basically became part of our family. If we hadn't moved, we would still be working with them. The whole team often went above and beyond, helping us in the day to day and in emergency situations. In particular, I will highlight how easy they make everything, from scheduling walks to communicating last minute requests. Further, they take security very seriously.
